explore.title: Explore offers
explore.lead: Public inventories from the community. You can browse without signing in; placing an order requires an account.
explore.emptyAll: There are no published offers yet.

about.purpose: A marketplace where Star Citizen miners publish their ore inventories and find buyers and sellers.
about.step1: Browse offers in Explore, no account needed.
about.step2: Log in with Discord to sell or buy.
about.step3: Create an inventory, add your ores and share its link.
about.step4: Manage requests in Orders, contact the other party on Discord and rate them when it is done.
about.more: Courrier-UEX is a Star Citizen companion desktop app.
about.support: Mine Market SC is free. If it is useful to you, a coffee helps keep it running.
